title: Scans for LiteLLM/Starlette (CVE-2026-42271, CVE-2026-48710), (Mon, Nov 16th)
content_md: This weekend, we started seeing requests for /mcp-rest/test/tools/list hitting our honeypots. These requests appear to attempt to exploit CVE-2026-42271 and CVE-2026-48710. Horizon3.ai published a short write-up about how these vulnerabilities can be chained to achieve remote code execution without authentication [Horizon3] Article Link: Scans for LiteLLM/Starlette (CVE-2026-42271, CVE-2026-48710)

CVE-2026-42271.evidence: Honeypots saw requests for /mcp-rest/test/tools/list that appear to attempt exploitation of the LiteLLM/Starlette chain; no successful compromise is reported.

CVE-2026-48710.evidence: Same honeypot requests target the chain described in Horizon3's write-up, but the event reports scan attempts rather than confirmed exploitation.
